mapper.select: SELECT afc.module_id, afc.form_id, afc.id AS column_id, afc.column_name, IFNULL(afcs.x_addr,afc.x_addr) x_addr, IFNULL(afcs.y_addr,afc.y_addr) y_addr FROM app_form_column afc LEFT JOIN app_form_column_sorting afcs ON afc.id = afcs.column_id WHERE afc.form_id = #{formId} ORDER BY y_addr,x_addr;
